description: JERICHO-E-usage supplies hourly useful-energy consumption profiles for Germany's 38 NUTS-2 regions. The research team separates residential, industrial, commerce and mobility sectors and distinguishes space, water and process heating, space and process cooling, mechanical energy, information and communication technology, and lighting. Figshare publishes a fixed data package under CC0 with free access, alongside a separately identified generation-code deposit. The inspected landing metadata establishes the regional and hourly resolution but does not independently establish the complete calendar span or internal table format. These profiles can define service demand in coupled electricity, heating and transport simulations, complementing data-when2heat-heat-demand-heat-pump-cop. A caveat is that useful-energy demand represents the required energy service before the assumed conversion technology. It should not be substituted directly for metered final electricity or fuel demand. Regional aggregation also conceals individual buildings and industrial processes. No profile package was downloaded, and totals or calendar alignment were not checked numerically.
